title: A COMPUTATIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR INTERPRETABLE TEXT-BASED PERSONALITY ASSESSMENT FROM SOCIAL MEDIA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a gender classification model's errors by testing for statistically significant differences in personality traits (MBTI dimensions and Big Five traits) between correctly and incorrectly classified users to see if specific personality profiles are disproportionately misclassified.

Comparing the overall predictive accuracy and misclassification error rates of a logistic regression gender classifier between male and female Reddit users (e.g., finding an 8.1% error rate for males versus 14.4% for females).

Analyzing if the age of users significantly differs between the correctly and incorrectly classified instances within a gender prediction model (e.g., observing that younger females were more likely to be misclassified).
